en: Color postcard showing a crowded seaside resort scene with swimmers and sunbathers on a rocky pier between two bodies of water, a rowboat/canoe with oars in the foreground, and three tall modern hotel towers and low resort buildings on a grassy bluff in the background. The reverse side is in Romanian, has printed fields for address, a price in lei, the caption EFORIE NORD, a photographer credit (Al. Florescu), and postal cancellations from Eforie Nord and București. Addressed to a recipient in Bucharest.
